profile.register_what: Bane NOR Sportabell platforms (track, length, height in mm, width, type) placed on the OSM track centreline, with the laser levels
profile.register_licence: facts from Bane NOR's station page (not open: facts only); line geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; NSR quays © Entur, NLOD
profile.register_text: Register: Bane NOR station page, track table (https://www.banenor.no/en/traffic-and-travel/railway-stations/-m-/moss/, read 2026-10-30): per track the platform length, height (mm above top of rail), width and type; no coordinates, so each platform is drawn on the OSM track centreline (see `x_geometry` per feature). Heights are Bane NOR's per-platform values, not classes.
